---
title: "Baseline Table 1 at start of follow up"
author: "Alex Pate"
date: "04/01/2024"
output: word_document
---

```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)

### Clear workspace
rm(list=ls())
# Sys.time()

### Source functions
R.func.sources = list.files("R", full.names = TRUE)
# sapply(R.func.sources, source)

### Read in cohort
cohort <- readRDS("../../../data/p5/cohort_prototype3.rds")

### Turn dichotomous factor variables into 0/1 numeric
for (var in colnames(cohort)){
  if (is.factor(cohort[,var])){
    if (length(levels(cohort[,var])) == 2){
      cohort[,var] <- as.numeric(cohort[,var]) - 1
    }
  }
}

###
### Create table 1
###
cohort.table1 <- dplyr::select(cohort, -c(patid, pracid
                                          ,cvd_time, cvd_indicator
                                          ,cvd_time_prim, cvd_indicator_prim
                                          ,cvd_time_hes, cvd_indicator_hes
                                          ,cvd_time_death, cvd_indicator_death
                                          ,bmi_alltime, sbp_alltime, sbp_var_alltime, cholhdl_ratio_alltime
                                          , fup_start, fup_end
                                          #, ethnicity.hes, ethnicity.prim
)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    postnatal_depression = dplyr::if_else(gender == 1, NA_real_, postnatal_depression),
    pre_eclampsia = dplyr::if_else(gender == 1, NA_real_, pre_eclampsia),
    impotence = dplyr::if_else(gender == 2, NA_real_, impotence)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(gender %in% c(1,2)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(gender = factor(gender, levels = c(2,1), labels = c("Female", "Male")),
                smoking = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(smoking, level = "Missing"),
                ethnicity = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(ethnicity, level = "Missing")) |>
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(by = gender,
                         type = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~  "continuous2",
                         missing = "no",
                         statistic = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ c("{median} ({p5}, {p25}, {p75}, {p95})",
                                                                     "{N_miss} ({p_miss}%)")) |>
  gtsummary::modify_table_body(
    dplyr::mutate,
    label = ifelse(label == "N missing (% missing)",
                   "Missing",
                   label)) |>
  gtsummary::modify_caption("Baseline characteristics of individuals at the start of their follow up")

### Convert to a compact Word-friendly table
table1_word <- cohort.table1 |>
  gtsummary::as_flex_table() |>
  flextable::theme_booktabs() |>
  flextable::font(
    fontname = "Arial",
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  flextable::fontsize(
    size = 8,
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  flextable::bold(
    part = "header"
  ) |>
  flextable::padding(
    padding.top = 1,
    padding.bottom = 1,
    padding.left = 2,
    padding.right = 2,
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  flextable::align(
    j = 1,
    align = "left",
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  flextable::align(
    j = 2:3,
    align = "center",
    part = "all"
  ) |>
  flextable::width(
    j = 1,
    width = 3.2
  ) |>
  flextable::width(
    j = 2:3,
    width = 1.6
  ) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(
    layout = "fixed",
    width = 1
  )

### Save directly to Word without using R Markdown/Pandoc
flextable::save_as_docx(
  `Baseline characteristics at the start of follow-up` = table1_word,
  path = "p2_table1_word_out.docx",
  align = "center"
)
```
